I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets in Moss's notes and sent Dana the list in our DM.

1. **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025, North team digests). Thea Ramaswell filed it on 4 Oct 2025 because the gatehouse kiosk wasn't sending text-message bay assignments for Dock Doors 14–18 at the Eau Claire yard. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
2. **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)", also in the North team digests. Thea logged it because the gatehouse scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to second-tier support for scanner firmware testing.

Things I flagged to Dana so they don't end up in the notes by mistake:
- **Not Quarrendon:** Moss's Central team handoff note has #4409 and #4412, but those are for Marrow Fieldworks. FR-882 in the same note is a Marrow Agrisupply feature request.
- **Similar name:** the cheat sheet warns not to mix up Quarrendon Freight Lines with Quarendon Freightways, which uses a competitor's software and isn't our customer.
- **No tickets:** Moss's other two Quarrendon notes (the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in) don't mention any ticket numbers.

I only looked at what Dana can see: Moss's six team digests in the shared files and the channels Dana is in. Moss has no notes folder of its own, and Moss hasn't posted in any of those channels. So the list covers the team digests only. Nothing needed approval: ticket numbers are operational facts, and I sent nothing outside our DM.
